==Purpose of template==

This template takes an input population number and outputs the name of a type of collection of people (settlement, military unit, etc) that roughly corresponds to that population size.

==How to use==

<code><nowiki>{{RoughPop|pop}}</nowiki></code>

==Tiers==
{|class=wikitable
!Minimum size!!Label
|-
|0||[[Shadar Logoth]]
|-
|1||[[:Category:Villages|Flyspeck]]
|-
|100||[[Company|Company]]
|-
|250||[[:Category:Villages|Village]]
|-
|5000||[[:Category:Towns|Town]]
|-
|25000||[[:Category:Cities|City]]
|-
|100000||[[:Category:Great Cities|Great City]]
|-
|250000||[[:Category:Nations|Nation]]
|-
|1000000||[[Seanchan|Empire]]
|-
|250000000||[[Age]]
|}

==Examples==

{|class=wikitable
!Code!!Result
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{RoughPop|50}}</nowiki></code>||{{RoughPop|50}}
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{RoughPop|200}}</nowiki></code>||{{RoughPop|200}}
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{RoughPop|pop=10000}}</nowiki></code>||{{RoughPop|pop=10000}}
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{RoughPop|999999999}}</nowiki></code>||{{RoughPop|999999999}}
|-
|<code><nowiki>{{RoughPop}}</nowiki></code>||{{RoughPop}}
|}
